source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség (Hungarian Banking Association) – member directory, fogalomtár, positions
why_relevant: Industry body that coordinates bank-side implementation of scheme deadlines and publishes consultation positions; its member/entity pages and glossary are a reliable actor-mapping aid for infrastructure operators (GIRO, BISZ, KELER).

source_name: Mastercard Hungary / mastercard.hu and Mastercard B2B newsroom (Hungary instant payments)
why_relevant: Card scheme's Hungarian-language public surface; Mastercard is also a technology supplier to the Hungarian instant payment build. Useful for detecting scheme-communicated product/portfolio changes affecting Hungarian issuers (e.g. reported withdrawal of a card product from the Hungarian market).

source_name: Hungarian acquirer merchant/POS acceptance manuals (proxy for card-scheme rules)
why_relevant: Card scheme rulebooks are member-confidential; acquirer-published 'Bankkártya elfogadói kézikönyv' documents restate scheme acceptance rules in Hungarian and are publicly downloadable — the best legal proxy for tracking scheme-mandated acceptance requirements at merchant/POS level.

source_name: MNB – A kártyatársaságokról (card schemes explainer)
why_relevant: Official Hungarian-language framing of card scheme roles and terminology (kártyatársaság); useful for glossary building and for identifying which schemes MNB treats as relevant in the HU market.

source_name: MNB Intézménykereső (institution/market participant search)
why_relevant: The master public register of every entity licensed or registered by the MNB: credit institutions, financial enterprises, payment institutions, e-money issuers, investment firms, funds, plus foreign providers passporting into Hungary and MNB/foreign warning lists. Converts the unknown HU regulated population into a named list whose own IR/press channels become sources.

source_name: MNB – Piaci szereplők keresése (register hub page)
why_relevant: Hub page that enumerates all MNB register instruments: general search, intermediary search, special databases, cross-border activity lists. The single best crawl seed for discovering every MNB-run register.

source_name: MNB – Közvetítők keresése (intermediary / agent register)
why_relevant: Separate registers for money-market (Hpt.) and insurance (Bit.) intermediaries, including dependent/independent agents and cross-border agents. This is the agent-register layer of the cell: it names the distribution channel population behind banks and PIs.

source_name: MNB – Speciális adatbázisok (special registers)
why_relevant: Index of niche registers: BEVA-eligible participants, EU covered bond label issuers, prospectus registers, authorised security printers, training organisations, cross-border fund manager agents. Each is a small named-actor list useful for enumerating adjacent payments/banking suppliers.

source_name: MNB – Magyar székhelyű intézmények határon átnyúló tevékenységei (outbound passporting lists)
why_relevant: Lists Hungarian payment institutions and credit institutions that passport services into other EEA states — identifies which HU payments actors are regionally expansionist, a direct lead-generation list.

source_name: MNB – Pénzforgalmi intézmény engedélyezés (licensing conditions & process page)
why_relevant: Authoritative statement of what a payment institution licence requires under Fsztv./Hpt., with sub-pages for tevékenységi engedély and személyi engedély. Explains the legal gates that determine who can appear in the register and on what timeline.

source_name: MNB – Elektronikuspénz-kibocsátó intézmény (EMI licensing pages)
why_relevant: The EMI counterpart of the PI licensing branch; defines the e-money issuer category whose members are then enumerable via Intézménykereső. Needed to build the correct Hungarian query vocabulary for EMI searches.

source_name: MNB alkalmazás-portál (alk.mnb.hu) – legacy supervision search apps
why_relevant: The underlying application host serving MNB's decision and warning search results, with paginated URLs (?pagenum=N) and an /en/ variant — a far more scrape-friendly surface than the CMS pages.

source_name: MNB – Hazai figyelmeztetések / jogosulatlan szolgáltatók (domestic warning lists)
why_relevant: The negative image of the licence register: entities operating without authorisation, and MNB immediate prohibition orders. Useful for scoping grey-market payments activity and for validating that a counterparty is genuinely licensed.

source_name: MNB – Pénzforgalmi intézmények adatszolgáltatás page
why_relevant: Supervisory reporting obligations and deadlines specific to payment institutions — the compliance calendar that drives PI behaviour, and a pointer to which data MNB collects (hence which aggregates may later be published).

source_name: MNB – Kriptoeszköz-szolgáltatók (CASP/MiCA) engedélyezés
why_relevant: MNB is the MiCA competent authority for Hungary; from 1 July 2025 CASPs need an MNB licence or an EU passport. A new, fast-moving licensed-actor population adjacent to payments, enumerable through the same Intézménykereső once entries appear.

source_name: EBA central register of payment and e-money institutions (PSD2)
why_relevant: Mirrors MNB's national register daily and adds passporting detail, in a downloadable machine-readable form. The most practical bulk-extraction route for the Hungarian PI/EMI/PISP/AISP population, and it also shows which foreign PIs passport into Hungary.

source_name: ECB list of Monetary Financial Institutions (MFI) – Hungary
why_relevant: Daily-updated authoritative list of HU credit institutions and money market funds, downloadable in bulk with stable identifiers — a clean deposit-taking-institution universe to join against MNB register names.

source_name: Cégszolgálat Online Céginformáció (e-cégjegyzék) – official company register
why_relevant: The statutory Hungarian company register (cégjegyzék). Resolves every licensed bank/PI/EMI/agent to a legal entity: cégjegyzékszám, seat, share capital, owners, officers, and status (felszámolás, végelszámolás). Reportedly offers machine-readable XML company data.

source_name: Céginformációs Szolgálat (Ministry of Justice company information service)
why_relevant: The state body governing access to company-register data, including bulk/customised data supply terms. Determines what is legally collectable from the cégjegyzék and at what price — a licensing/access gatekeeper for any register-based enumeration pipeline.

source_name: e-beszámoló portál (statutory financial statements)
why_relevant: Free filed annual accounts for every Hungarian company, including PIs, EMIs, fintechs and payment agents that are too small for MNB statistics. Turns a register name into revenue, headcount proxy and ownership narrative.

source_name: GIRO Zrt. – klíringtagok (BKR direct clearing participants)
why_relevant: Names every institution with direct access to the Hungarian interbank clearing system (BKR/GIROInstant). This is the operational, not merely legal, list of payment-capable institutions — the highest-value subset for payments infrastructure work.

source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség – Tagjaink (banking association member list)
why_relevant: Curated list of 40+ member institutions with individual member profile pages (including infrastructure firms such as GIRO Zrt.), each carrying contact and website details — a fast route from register name to the actor's own disclosure channels.

source_name: MNB Szanálás – közzétételek / határozatok (resolution decisions)
why_relevant: Resolution-authority publications: which institutions have entered resolution or had resolution measures applied. Rare but high-signal events that remove or transform actors in the register.

source_name: MNB archive – Felügyelt intézmények / Piaci szereplők (legacy PSZÁF-era register pages)
why_relevant: Archived register structures from the PSZÁF/early-MNB era. Valuable for historical baselining — reconstructing which institutions existed in earlier years and how categories were named before the current taxonomy.

source_name: MNB – Pénzfeldolgozási tevékenység engedélyezése (cash-processing licence)
why_relevant: A separate MNB licence category covering cash-processing (CIT/cash-handling) firms — directly adjacent to ATM/branch/self-service hardware markets and often overlooked because it sits outside the main felügyelet register tree.

source_name: OTP Bank – Bankszámla hirdetmények és üzletszabályzatok (retail current accounts)
why_relevant: OTP is the largest HU bank; retail account hirdetmények carry statutory 2-month/15-day pre-announcements and usually name the triggering jogszabály (payment law, transaction tax, fee-cap decrees). Most precise dated evidence of which regulation bites and when.

source_name: OTP Bank – Vállalkozói és vállalati hirdetmények és üzletszabályzatok
why_relevant: Corporate/SME tariff notices; corporate payment pricing changes are the fastest read-out of transaction-tax and payment-regulation pass-through to business clients.
